instrument: Data Center Temporary Moratorium Ordinance (amended; final reading Oct 6, 2026)
summary: Would impose a temporary moratorium to prevent applications from vesting under existing regulations while permanent rules are written: applications accepted for docketing and completeness review only, not processed, scheduled, heard or approved; waiver process; study committee including the health department, engineering and MLGW.

source.citation: City of Memphis draft ordinance (v3) and council release, Sept 2026

notes: Daily Memphian reports questions about the council's authority under Tennessee law.
confidence_note: Draft read; amended version for final reading not read.

next.event: Memphis City Council final reading: data center moratorium and regulations
